module_outcomes: Ukuthola kanye nokuchaza izigaba zekhompyutha eziyisisekelo, izingxenye, kanye
Ukuchaza izinhlobo zezinhlelokusebenza zekhompyutha, ukusebenza kwazo kanye nokuguquguquka kwazo.
Ukwenza iziphakamiso mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo, izinhlelokusebenza, kanye nezinye izimfuneko.
Ukusebenzisa umbikombani kanye ne-inthanethi ekuxhumaneni, ekusebenzisaneni, kanye nasekutholeni ulwazi.
Ukuchaza umthelela (omuhle kanye nongemuhle) wobuchwepheshe bamakhompyutha kanye nezinhlelo zolwazi emiphakathini yesimanje.
Ukusebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza ukwakha kanye nokunakekela izindawo zokugcina imidanti ngokohlelo ukuze kube lula ukugcina kanye nokukhipha/nokuthola amafayela.
Ukwakha, ukuhlela kanye nokuhlunga amadokhumenti enziwe nge-word processing.
Ukukhombisa ulwazi olusebenzisekayo uma kuthuthukiswa amadokhumenti ngokusebenzisa isizindalwazi kanye nezinye izinsizakusebenza eziwusizo. Ukusebenzisa kanye nokwakha iznhlobo ezithuthukile ze-word.

module_purpose: Lesi sifundo sakhelwe ukungenisa abafundi ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Sizolungiselela abafundi ukuba baqonde futhi basebenzise ubuchwepheshe ngezindlela ezifanele, ezisebenzayo kanye nezinenqubonhle. Sinikezela ngamathub okuthola ulwazi bukhoma ngokusebenzisa amakhompyutha (ahlala edeskini, aphathwayo). Kugcizelelwa ukusetshenziswa kwamakhompyutha emphakathini kanye nomthelela wawo ezimpilweni zabantu kanye nokusetshenziswa kwawo ngenkambisonhle. Uhlelokusebenza lokukhiqiza olutholakala kulesi sifundo luhlanganisa i-word processing, umbikonyazi, ukuhlwaya izizindalwazi, kanye namasu okuhlwaya. •
